notes: Google's official Watch Face Format Complications sample in android/wear-os-samples. WatchFaceFormat/Complications is a standalone Gradle build with codeless :watchface module carrying res/raw/watchface.xml (five complication slots across radial/arc/circle layouts plus one color palette user configuration). Rendered through compose-preview's DWF RemoteCompose lane, which extracts previews/<id>.watchface.json and ir/<id>.rc for live complication slot, ambient, time, and user-configuration overrides.
